name: @lango-project/lango-api
description: HTTP API host for Lango applications.

scripts.build: lango build src/cli.lango --out dist/cli.mjs --executable && lango build src/tokens.lango --out dist/tokens.mjs
scripts.test: lango test src/cli.lango --build-dir .test-output/source && npm run test:tokens && npm run test:http && npm run test:ping && npm run test:revocation && npm run test:state
scripts.test:tokens: lango build src/tokens_test.lango --out .test-output/tokens_test.mjs --executable && node .test-output/tokens_test.mjs && lango build src/session_lifetime_test.lango --out .test-output/session_lifetime_test.mjs --executable && node .test-output/session_lifetime_test.mjs
scripts.test:http: lango build src/auth_http_test.lango --out .test-output/auth_http_test.mjs --executable && node .test-output/auth_http_test.mjs && npm run test:lifecycle
scripts.test:lifecycle: lango build src/lifecycle_http_test.lango --out .test-output/lifecycle_http_test.mjs --executable && node .test-output/lifecycle_http_test.mjs && npm run test:audit
scripts.test:state: lango build src/state_test.lango --out .test-output/state_test.mjs --executable && node .test-output/state_test.mjs && lango build src/state_http_test.lango --out .test-output/state_http_test.mjs --executable && node .test-output/state_http_test.mjs
